column1: # ZAP baseline rule file for the public Texas Home Outlet storefront.
# A line starting with # is a comment. Unlisted rules stay at ZAP's default, WARN.
# WARN does not fail the weekly job. See docs/ZAP_BASELINE.md.
# 10109 Modern Web Application is informational. ZAP raises it when the site
# behaves like a JavaScript application. https://www.texashomeoutlet.com is a React SPA.
# 10096 Timestamp Disclosure matches Unix-epoch-looking integers inside
# content-hashed Vite bundles. Those integers are not credentials or customer data.
# 10049 Storable and Cacheable Content on /assets/ only. Those files are
# content-hashed and served public, max-age=31536000, immutable on purpose.
# The same rule still WARNs for HTML and API responses, which are no-store.
